$comment: Font metrics extracted from the EDS CDN variable fonts, for build-time cap-height
and x-height calculations. Metrics only — no font binaries are vendored, because the
Equinor typeface licence prohibits duplication and distribution.
size-adjust is NOT emitted. The x-height correction is baked into the header font-size tokens instead, so one number serves CSS, Figma and React Native — see DECISIONS.md 5.

Inter.vendored: fonts/InterVariable.woff2 — SIL OFL 1.1 permits it; offline/stage safety (venue wifi). Equinor stays CDN+local(): its licence forbids vendoring.

Equinor.licence: Proprietary — Equinor ASA. Do not vendor or redistribute.

discrepancies.issue: size-adjust does not achieve x-height alignment
discrepancies.detail: Shipped CSS uses 105.9% for Equinor and 95.2% for CommitMono, both labelled 'Match Inter x-height'. Computed from current metrics, alignment requires 113.73% and 101.09% respectively. decisions.md records 113.6363%, which matches the computed value.
discrepancies.hypothesis: Values likely calculated against an earlier Equinor VF with a larger x-height (105.9% implies ~0.5155 vs today's 0.480) and not recalculated after a font update. Unverified.
discrepancies.impact: At 105.9% Equinor's x-height renders at ~93% of Inter's, so the faces remain visibly mismatched.
discrepancies.status: resolved — confirmed a miscalculation. The correction is now derived and baked into header font sizes rather than transcribed into a font descriptor.
